leads.title: Kenyan Penal Code of 1930, as revised in 2006 - Sections 162, 163, 165
leads.documents: Criminal status and penalties for same-sex sexual activity: sodomy/ carnal knowledge against order of nature and gross indecency.
leads.detail: Sec.162 liable 14 years, 21 years with aggravating non-consent/force; Sec.163 attempt 7 years; Sec.165 indecent practices between males 5 years

leads.title: Constitution of Kenya (effective 27 August 2010) - Articles 2, 10, 19, 20, 24, 27, 28, 31, 45(2)
leads.documents: Legal framework for LGBTQ status: Art.45(2) limits marriage to opposite sex; Art.27 equality/non-discrimination, Art.28 dignity, Art.31 privacy cited as basis to challenge Penal Code.
leads.detail: Cited as Constitution of Kenya 2010, Art.45(2) 'right to marry a person of the opposite sex'; Art.27(4)-(5) non-discrimination grounds

leads.title: Eric Gitari v Attorney General & another (Petition no. 150 of 2016) - High Court of Kenya ruling 24 May 2019
leads.documents: Failed decriminalization challenge to Sections 162(a)(c) and 165; court refused to declare them unconstitutional.
leads.detail: Filed 2016 by NGLHRC executive director Eric Gitari; heard 22-23 Feb 2018; ruling delayed from 22 Feb 2019 to 24 May 2019; appeal noted; Court of Appeal hearing scheduled May 2026

leads.title: Court of Appeal in Mombasa - ruling 22 March 2018 on forced anal examinations
leads.documents: Enforcement practice: forced anal exams, HIV/hepatitis B tests on accused gay men ruled unconstitutional, reversing 2016 High Court decision.
leads.detail: Case from Feb 2015 arrest of two men in Kwale County, exams at Mombasa's Madaraka Hospital; filed by National Gay and Lesbian Human Rights Commission (NGLHRC); related halted exam at Kangundo Level 4 hospital / Kangundo magistrate court

leads.title: High Court of Kenya - August 2025 transgender rights ruling
leads.documents: Landmark trans rights finding: violations of freedom from torture/cruel treatment, equality/non-discrimination, dignity, freedom/security of person, privacy unconstitutional.
leads.detail: Ordered parliament to enact 'Transgender Protection Rights Act, or, in the alternative, amendments of the Intersex Persons Bill 2024'

leads.title: High Court of Kenya - 20 May 2026 gender-marker ruling - Audrey Mbugua lawsuit
leads.documents: Gender identity recognition: Kenyans must be allowed to change gender markers on ID documents/birth certificates.
leads.detail: Lawsuit filed in 2020 by transgender activist Audrey Mbugua and two others seeking to amend birth certificates

leads.title: Kenya Human Rights Commission - 2011 report on LGBTI persons
leads.documents: Enforcement abuse despite few convictions under Sec.162-165: police harassment, remand beyond constitutional period, trumped-up charges, extortion/blackmail, bribes/sexual favours, rape by officers.
leads.detail: Cited as Kenya Human Rights Commission reported in 2011; includes quote on LGBTI sex workers mostly MSMs asked for bribes and sexual favours

leads.title: National Gay and Lesbian Human Rights Commission (NGLHRC) - 2020-2021 report
leads.documents: Recent enforcement incidents: police demanding bribes from LGBTI persons.
leads.detail: Cited as Nairobi-based National Gay and Lesbian Human Rights Commission 2020-2021 report

leads.title: Kenya National Commission on Human Rights - April 2012 report
leads.documents: Trans-specific rights machinery failure: stigma/discrimination, no access to gender re-assignment therapy, detention-cell and bathroom risks, identity problems.
leads.detail: Cites witness denied surgery by Kenyatta National Hospital, failed appeal to Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentist's Board; no statutory provisions for transgender rights / no legal means to change gender

leads.title: Family Protection Bill - National Assembly file ref DLS/NA/BILLS/2/18/2023
leads.documents: Pending escalation risk: would punish 'aggravated homosexuality' with death, criminalize promotion, restrict privacy/assembly/pride parades, monitor spaces, remove LGBTQ topics from curricula, overturn 2023 Supreme Court association-rights decision.
leads.detail: Written/introduced 2023 by MP George Peter Opondo Kaluma; inspired by Uganda Anti-Homosexuality Act; before Committee on Social Protection for pre-publication scrutiny for ~2 years
